user.title: Anova Ovens
user.description:
Enter your Anova Personal Access Token (starts with `anova-`).

**Optional:** your Anova app email and password, needed for the lamp and the camera on v2 ovens. Your password is not stored; only the sign-in's refresh token is kept. If you sign in to Anova with Google, Facebook or Apple, first set a password on the [Anova password reset page](https://anovaculinary.io/ali/password-reset). You can also add or change the login later under **Configure**.

send_command.name: Send raw command
send_command.description: Advanced: send a CMD_APO_* command to the oven and return Anova's reply. Intended for testing undocumented commands; it can start or stop cooks.

payload.name: Payload
payload.description: Inner command payload, if the command takes one.

cooker_id.name: Cooker ID
cooker_id.description: Only needed when more than one oven is set up.

use_app_login.name: Use app login
use_app_login.description: Send over the Anova app login instead of the Personal Access Token.

app_login.title: Anova app login (optional)
app_login.description:
Your Personal Access Token is not allowed to control the lamp or the oven camera. Signing in with your Anova app email and password lets Home Assistant control the lamp and the oven camera (v2 ovens) the way the app does.

This needs an email and password login. If you sign in to Anova with Google, Facebook or Apple, first set a password on the [Anova password reset page](https://anovaculinary.io/ali/password-reset) using your account's email, then enter it here.

Your password is not stored. This is unofficial and may stop working if Anova changes its app. Leave the email empty to remove the login.

camera.title: Oven camera (optional)
camera.description:
The oven's camera works on v2 ovens while cooking, and needs the app login. The oven streams video in a format Home Assistant can't read directly, so the camera also needs the **Anova Camera Relay** app (add-on) from this repository: add `https://github.com/rawmediaau/anova-ovens` as an app repository, install and start Anova Camera Relay, then enter its hostname below (shown on the app's Info page, for example `abcd1234-anova-camera-relay`).

The relay only pulls video from Anova while something is reading it, and snapshots are cheap. **Live view** converts the video to H264 while someone is watching, which uses noticeably more CPU; leave it off for snapshots only.

Leave the relay empty to turn the camera off.
